name: gpu6
label: 6 GB graphics card, 16 GB memory (the reference laptop)
plain: The worker (the model that writes code) lives on the graphics card and never leaves it. The router is a tiny model on the processor. The heavy model only steps in when the worker fails, and it swaps the worker out while it works.

router.why: tiny, answers in a second on the processor; no graphics memory used

worker.why: 7B at 4-bit fits the card with an 8k memory when the desktop is not using it; tune steps down if not

heavy.why: 14B at 4-bit: about half on the card, half in RAM; slow but noticeably smarter

draft.why: a 0.5B helper that guesses the worker's next words; kept only if it fits with room and measures faster

evidence: researched defaults; `tune` measures this machine and may step the worker's quant or context down until it is fully on the GPU
